name: TreeRow
intent: Presentational hierarchical row with indentation and an expand/collapse affordance for tree-structured lists.
when: Render a bespoke nested/tree list outside a data table

chooseOver.because: DataTable's getSubRows tree model is for tabular data with columns; TreeRow is a standalone row primitive for custom hierarchical lists

commonMistakes.mistake: Mix TreeRow with DataTable getSubRows for the same data
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Mix TreeRow with DataTable getSubRows for the same data — choose one tree mechanism (see fm-dt-3)

extracted: cva variants/sizes remain generated by the structural extractor

lineage.confidence: unset — projection round-trip verified; no held-out eval yet

props.name: accentBorder
props.description: Left border accent color class from your own CSS (e.g. "border-primary")

props.name: groupPosition
props.description: Position within a contiguous group of selected rows. When set, adjacent selected rows collapse their borders and rounding so the group reads as a single block. - "first": rounded top, square bottom - "middle": no rounding, no top border - "last": square top, rounded bottom, no top border

usage: Use TreeRow to display structured data or visualizations. This component helps users understand and interact with complex information sets.

TreeRow is ideal for dashboards, reports, and data-heavy interfaces. Ensure data is presented clearly and consider responsive behavior for different screen sizes. Provide appropriate loading states for async data.

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.
